sources: tbe_guidance
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/tick-borne-encephalitis-epidemiology-diagnosis-and-prevention
UKHSA tick-borne encephalitis guidance
TBE epidemiology, diagnosis, prevention and travel-related risk
The guidance covers tick-borne encephalitis epidemiology, clinical features, diagnosis and prevention.
Assessment requires geography, tick or food exposure, vaccination status and laboratory evidence.
tbe_green_book
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/tick-borne-encephalitis-the-green-book-chapter-31
UKHSA tick-borne encephalitis Green Book chapter
TBE immunisation information for public-health and travel-health professionals
The chapter provides tick-borne encephalitis immunisation information for public-health professionals.
Vaccine use depends on destination, activity, season, duration and individual clinical assessment.
tbe_hairs
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/hairs-risk-assessment-tick-borne-encephalitis
UKHSA HAIRS tick-borne encephalitis assessment
qualitative risk assessment of tick-borne encephalitis for the UK population
The publication records a HAIRS assessment of tick-borne encephalitis risk.
Its qualitative conclusions depend on surveillance, vector, animal, human and geographic evidence at the assessment date.
yellow_fever_guidance
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/yellow-fever-guidance-data-and-analysis
UKHSA yellow-fever guidance, data and analysis
yellow-fever epidemiology, transmission, symptoms, diagnosis and traveller prevention
The guidance covers yellow-fever epidemiology, transmission, symptoms, diagnosis and prevention.
It advises checking current destination vaccine recommendations and certificate requirements before travel.
japanese_encephalitis_green_book
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/japanese-encephalitis-the-green-book-chapter-20
UKHSA Japanese encephalitis Green Book chapter
Japanese encephalitis immunisation information for public-health professionals
The publication provides Japanese encephalitis immunisation information for public-health professionals.
It identifies Japanese encephalitis as a mosquito-borne flaviviral encephalitis and links current travel-health guidance.
oropouche_gap_map
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/oropouche-virus-a-rapid-evidence-gap-map
UKHSA Oropouche virus rapid evidence gap map
mapping of available Oropouche-virus research for prioritisation
The evidence gap map categorises available Oropouche-virus research by topic, design and geography.
It identified 269 studies using a search completed on 5 June 2025 and is not clinical operational guidance.
west_nile_hairs
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/hairs-risk-assessment-west-nile-virus
UKHSA HAIRS West Nile virus assessment
qualitative assessment of West Nile virus risk to the UK population
The publication provides a HAIRS assessment of West Nile virus risk.
Conclusions depend on current vector, bird, animal, human, climate and travel evidence.
usutu_hairs
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/hairs-risk-assessment-usutu-virus
UKHSA HAIRS Usutu virus assessment
qualitative assessment of Usutu-virus risk to the UK population
The publication provides a HAIRS assessment of Usutu virus risk.
Its scope and confidence depend on surveillance and evidence available at the stated assessment date.
andes_hairs
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/hairs-risk-assessment-andes-virus
UKHSA HAIRS Andes virus assessment
qualitative assessment of Andes-virus risk to the UK population
The publication provides a HAIRS assessment concerning Andes virus.
Its conclusions must be interpreted with geographic exposure, transmission evidence and stated uncertainty.
